policy: Every number in ShasthoSathi traces to a named source. Nothing synthetic. Unavailable data is disclosed, never invented. Compiled 2026-09-06.

dengue_monthly_2023.source: Hossain M, Rakib MSI, Hasan MM, Powshi SN, Islam EI, Islam NN. The 2023 dengue outbreak in Bangladesh. Health Science Reports 2025;8(5):e70852. doi:10.1002/hsr2.70852 (Table 1)
dengue_monthly_2023.verification: Crossref-verified 2026-09-06; monthly values sum to the official DGHS total 321,179

dengue_annual.source: DGHS/IEDCR/WHO figures as reported by: IEDCR National Bulletin (nbph.iedcr.gov.bd/an-update-on-dengue/), WHO Disease Outbreak News 2023-DON481, PMC7535344 (2019: 101,354/179), Outbreak News Today + NewsOnAir (2024: 101,214/575), Xinhua/Beacon 28-Dec-2025 (2025: 102,562/412), Wikipedia 2023-outbreak article (2000: 5,551/93; 2022 deaths 281)

weather_dhaka_monthly.source: Open-Meteo archive API (archive-api.open-meteo.com), Dhaka 23.8103N 90.4125E, daily mean temperature / precipitation / relative humidity aggregated to months, 2022-01..2026-09

divisions_geojson.source: geoBoundaries gbOpen BGD ADM1 (github.com/wmgeolab/geoBoundaries), 8 divisions, simplified

division_population.source: Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics, Population & Housing Census 2022 (PEC-adjusted; division figures via citypopulation.de credited to BBS)
division_population.verification: sums to 169,828,911; Wikipedia census article carries the enumerated variant (165,158,616; Dhaka 44,444,723) — adjustment noted

clinical_content.who_warning_signs: WHO 2009 Dengue guidelines (iris.who.int, ISBN 9789241547871); validation Hadinegoro 2012 doi:10.1179/2046904712z.00000000052 (Crossref-verified)
clinical_content.home_care: WHO dengue fact sheet + CDC dengue clinical guidance (paracetamol only; avoid NSAIDs; days 3-7 critical)
clinical_content.epi: Bangladesh EPI via WHO IRIS BD document + PMC9984999

disclosed_gaps: DGHS dashboard monthly 2024/2025 series is JS-rendered (not machine-readable): the forecast model uses the peer-reviewed 2023 monthly series only; 2024/2025 appear as annual validation checks.
arXiv 2507.03264 fetched during research was a mathematics paper (wrong candidate) -> rejected, never cited.
Wikipedia-vs-citypopulation Dhaka division figure differs by PEC adjustment (44,444,723 enumerated vs 45,644,586 adjusted); the adjusted consistent set is used and stated.
